env.buildCommand:
export HOME=$TMPDIR
cp -r /nix/store/5nanv3ik3iwbxpjbsnw0vsbsvkq4cqia-project-source project
chmod -R u+w project
cd project
mkdir legacy-inputs
if pip-purifier prefetch --inputs "$PWD/legacy-inputs" --venv legacy-env >legacy.log 2>&1; then
  echo 'legacy inputs without their target interpreter were accepted' >&2
  exit 1
fi
grep -q 'offline inputs have no target Python' legacy.log
/nix/store/bfzqwgi4i3mif463mdwiarpq5w270hmx-python3-3.11.17/bin/python3.11 -m venv --without-pip .venv
if pip-purifier prefetch --inputs /nix/store/a2ii5z50sm2rrsb72x211477ff2gp0ww-pip-purifier-inputs >wrong.log 2>&1; then
  echo 'prefetch accepted an existing environment with another interpreter' >&2
  exit 1
fi
grep -q 'Recreate the virtual environment' wrong.log
test -x .venv/bin/python
rm -rf .venv

pip-purifier prefetch --inputs /nix/store/a2ii5z50sm2rrsb72x211477ff2gp0ww-pip-purifier-inputs
export PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH"
python - <<'PYTHON'
import socket
try:
    socket.create_connection(('1.1.1.1', 443), timeout=5)
except OSError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('external network is reachable: sandbox required')
PYTHON
test "$(greet)" = 'hello attrs=25.3.0 docopt=0.6.2 yaml=6.0.3'
mkdir -p $out
cp pip-purifier.lock.json $out/
python - <<'PYTHON' > $out/runtime.json
import importlib.metadata as m, json, platform, sys
print(json.dumps({'python': sys.version, 'executable': sys.executable,
                  'platform': platform.platform(),
                  'distributions': sorted((d.metadata['Name'], d.version) for d in m.distributions())}, indent=2))
PYTHON
env.name: pip-purifier-ordinary-development
